fields.description: Cluster whose mail this pool sends. Only gateways of the same cluster can host its addresses.
fields.label: Cluster

fields.description: Assigned on first save: p1, p2 and so on. It names the relay listener and connection strategy on the gateways and cannot change afterwards.
fields.label: Pool Name

fields.description: Display name shown in lists and links, e.g. Dedicated pool for Acme. Defaults to the hostname.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Port the cluster relays to on every gateway hosting this pool. Assigned on save, starting at 2525, one per pool.
fields.label: Relay Port

fields.description: Pool name, then .out., then the cluster zone, e.g. p1.out.blr.frappemail.com. Resolves to every gateway hosting an address of the pool; the cluster relays to it. The out sub-zone is what the gateway certificates cover.
fields.label: Hostname

fields.description: The IP addresses mail leaves from, each on a gateway of this cluster. An address can belong to one pool only. Adding or removing rows updates DNS, the SPF include and both servers' configuration on save.
fields.label: Addresses
